title: Ana's Day
text:
Ana wakes up at seven o'clock every morning. She takes a shower and eats bread with coffee. Then she goes to school by bus. School starts at eight.

In the afternoon, Ana comes home at four. She does her homework at the kitchen table. After dinner, she reads a book. She goes to bed at nine.

questions.text: What time does Ana wake up?
Where does Ana do her homework?
What can we say about Ana?
options: She has a busy and organized day.
She does not go to school.

questions.text: Why does Ana probably read a book after dinner?
options: She wants to relax before bed.
She has to go to work.

paragraph_translations: Ana acorda às sete horas todas as manhãs. Ela toma banho e come pão com café. Depois, ela vai para a escola de ônibus. A aula começa às oito.
À tarde, Ana chega em casa às quatro. Ela faz a lição de casa na mesa da cozinha. Depois do jantar, ela lê um livro. Ela vai para a cama às nove.
